paragraphs.text: Use this endpoint to retrieve the list of available App Store categories and subcategories. Associate an app with categories using the `PATCH-v1-appInfos-_id_` endpoint.
The first example retrieves the full category and subcategory hierarchy in one request. The second example retrieves just the top-level categories for macOS apps.
